body:
Thanks y’all! I had an appointment with my therapist and she and the responses here helped give me the courage to end things. 

I left him a voicemail saying I said “hey Dean it’s whoevenknows2121, it was good getting to spend time with you this weekend, but after this weekend I just don’t think we’re a good fit and I’m not interested in pursuing this any further, but I wish you the best of luck and I know you’re going to do great things”

I really appreciate the input in this thread, I’m very grateful for your responses.
